decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed  part single storey side extension/ porch would, by reason of its  position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers  and is contrary to the Policies  ENV-B 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.     

2/ The proposed  part single storey side extension/ porch would, by reason of its  appearance, not serve to preserve the character of the  Osterley Park Conservation Area and is contrary to the Policies  ENV-B 2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003).
description: Erection of part  single storey side extension to form front porch  and the insertion of two rooflights to the rear roofslope and one rooflight to the front roofslope with a loft conversion to create habitable roof space to the house.
